items.title: MFA Not Enforced for Admin Users
items.description: Multi-factor authentication is not required for administrator accounts in your Microsoft 365 tenant.
items.remediation: Navigate to Azure Active Directory > Security > Conditional Access and create a policy requiring MFA for all admin roles.

items.title: Excessive OAuth Permissions Granted
items.description: Third-party application 'Zapier' has been granted full read/write access to Google Workspace data.
items.remediation: Review OAuth app permissions in Google Admin Console and restrict to minimum required scopes.
